SELECT id, name
FROM users
WHERE active = 1
ORDER BY name;

SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.name
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 3;

WITH recent AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM sessions
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
)
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM recent
GROUP BY user_id;

CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user_created
ON orders (user_id, created_at DESC);

SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id)
  user_id,
  created_at,
  wpm
FROM sessions
ORDER BY user_id, wpm DESC, created_at DESC;

UPDATE products p
SET price = p.price * 0.9
FROM inventory i
WHERE i.product_id = p.id
  AND i.quantity > 100
  AND p.category = 'clearance';
